main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|moment}}, from {{der|en|fro|moment}}, from {{der|en|la|mōmentum}}. {{doublet|en|momentum|movement}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈməʊmənt/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmoʊmənt/|/ˈmolmɛnt/|a=GenAm}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈməʊmənt̞/|a=IE}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈmʌo̞mən/|a=Dublin}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-moment.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|mo|ment}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# A [[particular]] [[point]], or relatively [[small]] [[region]].
## A particular point of [[space]]; a [[spot]].
##: {{syn|en|point|spot}}
##* {{Q|en|year=1905|{{w|E. M. Forster}}|{{w|Where Angels Fear to Tread}}|, chapter 7, third paragraph|quote=...over everything there lay a deposit of heavy white dust, which was only blown off one '''moment''' to thicken on another.}}
## A particular point of [[time]]; an [[instant]].
##: {{syn|en|instant|minute|Thesaurus:point in time}}
##* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=5|passage=Here, in the transept and choir, where the service was being held, one was conscious every '''moment''' of an increasing brightness; colours glowing vividly beneath the circular chandeliers, and the rows of small lights on the choristers' desks flashed and sparkled in front of the boys' faces, deep linen collars, and red neckbands.}}
##* {{Q|en|year=1976|Richard Duprey|Duel on the Wind|, part 4, chapter 1|quote="You know, we all have our own lives to live. Now and then we get confused, we become weak and vulnerable. We have to look around for help. Sometimes we get lucky and there's someone who loves us to support us, to help us along. We have a right, being human, to those '''moment'''s of weakness. We have a right to get confused and ask for help. [...] But when that help is offered and accepted, we don't have a right to remain confused forever, to keep those who help us standing by in a kind of limbo..."}}
# A [[brief]], unspecified amount of [[time]].
#: {{syn|en|stound|instant|trice|Thesaurus:moment}}
#: {{ux|en|Wait a '''moment''', while I lock the front door.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=5|passage=Then came a maid with hand-bag and shawls, and after her a tall young lady. She stood for a '''moment''' holding her skirt above the grimy steps,{{...}}, and the light of the reflector fell full upon her.}}
#* {{RQ:Travers Cuckoo in the Nest|chapter=6|passage=Sophia broke down here. Even at this '''moment''' she was subconsciously comparing her rendering of the part of the forlorn bride with Miss Marie Lohr's.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-14|author=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/profile/sam-leith Sam Leith]
|volume=189|issue=1|page=37|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/books/2013/may/23/holy-shit-history-swearing-mohr Where the profound meets the profane]
|passage=Swearing doesn't just mean what we now understand by "dirty words". It is entwined, in social and linguistic history, with the other sort of swearing: vows and oaths. Consider for a '''moment''' the origins of almost any word we have for bad language – "profanity", "curses", "oaths" and "swearing" itself.}}
# {{lb|en|figurative}} [[weight|Weight]] or [[importance]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Richard 3|3|7|line=67|text=In deep designs, in matter of great '''moment''', / No less importing than our general good.}}
#* {{RQ:Swift Gulliver|part=II|page=176|passage=However, upon a ſtrict Review, I blotted out ſeveral Paſſages of leſs '''Moment''' which were in my firſt Copy, for fear of being cenſured as tedious and trifling, whereof Travellers are often, perhaps not without Juſtice, accuſed.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1904|author=w:Arthur Conan Doyle|title=w:The Adventure of the Second Stain|publisher=Norton|year_published=2005|page=1192
|passage=The document in question is of such immense importance that its publication might very easily – I might almost say probably – lead to European complications of the utmost '''moment'''.}}
# {{senseid|en|Q13222844}} {{lb|en|physics|mechanics}} A [[product#English:_multiplication|product]] of a [[distance]] and another physical [[quantity]].<!--[[w:moment (physics)]]-->
#: {{hypo|en|moment<id:Q48103><qq:torque sense>|moment of force<id:Q48103>|torque<id:Q48103>}}
#: {{cot|en|couple<id:Q253897>}}
## {{senseid|en|Q48103}} {{lb|en|physics|mechanics}} {{ellipsis of|en|moment of force<id:Q48103>}}.
##: {{syn|en|torque<id:Q48103>}}
# {{lb|en|historical|unit}} A definite period of time, specifically one-tenth of a [[point]], or one-fortieth or one-fiftieth of an [[hour]].
# {{lb|en|neurology|informal}} A [[petit mal]] episode; such a [[spell]].
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} A [[fit]]; a brief [[tantrum]].
# {{lb|en|math}} An infinitesimal change in a varying quantity; an increment or decrement.
# {{lb|en|math}} A [[quantitative]] [[measure]] of the [[shape]] of a [[set]] of [[point]]s.
#: {{ux|en|If the points represent mass, then the zeroth '''moment''' is the total mass, the first moment divided by the total mass is the center of mass, and the second moment is the rotational inertia.}}
# {{lb|en|Internet slang|frequently|derogatory|usually|preceded by a noun}} An [[embarrassing]] event, supposed to be [[characteristic]] of some [[person]], [[group]], or [[situation]].
#: {{ux|en|woman '''moment'''}}
#: {{ux|en|Reddit '''moment'''}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial|Internet slang|of a person}} The current center of public [[attention]] and [[awe]]; the most important [[celebrity]] in their [[prime]].
#: {{ux|en|She’s got a point. She’s an icon, she is a legend, and she is '''the moment'''. Now, come on, now. You got to give it up to Kim.}}
